Messages.Author: LSJ
Messages.Body:
pallando wrote:
>
> i was wondering what happens when i play immortal grapple when i combat with
> an ally like succubus or nephandus? succubus does 1 aggravated damege,
> nephandus 1R. do their strikes qualify as hand stirkes or don't they have
> any strikes when grappled?

Rulings:

* Hand Strike: any non-ranged, non-weapon strike that deals damage based
on the striking minion's hand damage, or any minion's non-ranged
damage-dealing innate strike. [LSJ 24-FEB-1997]

Rulebook:

6.4.5. Strike Effects

Hand Strike. The default strike is a hand strike. When a minion strikes
with a hand strike at close range, he does an amount of damage equal to his
strength* to the opposing minion. Vampires have a default strength of one,
while allies have a default strength of zero.

--

Messages.Body:
pallando wrote:
>
> this is very nice. i am not sure though if it answers my question: do
> succubus and nephandus have a strike when grappled?
>

> LSJ <vte...@white-wolf.com> schrieb in im Newsbeitrag:

> > Rulings:

> >
> > * Hand Strike: any non-ranged, non-weapon strike that deals damage
> based
> > on the striking minion's hand damage, or any minion's non-ranged
> > damage-dealing innate strike. [LSJ 24-FEB-1997]
> >

> > Rulebook:
> >
> > 6.4.5. Strike Effects
> >
> > Hand Strike. The default strike is a hand strike. When a minion strikes
> > with a hand strike at close range, he does an amount of damage equal to
> his

> > strength* to the opposing minion. Vampires have a default strength of one,
> > while allies have a default strength of zero.

Immortal Grapple prevents either minion from using any strike that is
not a hand strike. Whether a minion "has" a strike or not is not the
question - a minion always has a hand strike, so always has a strike
when grappled (unless they're prevented from using the hand strike -
if they've maneuvered with a different strike or with a weapon, for
example).

The question is "what effect does a minion's hand strike have?" (or,
alternatively, "is <some given strike> a hand strike?")

E.g.: Nephandus can use his hand strike. Since his '1R' strike is
ranged, it doesn't qualify as a hand strike, per the definition given.
So Nephandus' hand strike deals damage equal to his strength, as stated
above (which defaults to 0, as stated above) damage. He strikes for zero
damage.

E.g.: Succubus can use her hand strike. Her "1 agg" innate strike
qualifies as a hand strike, per the definition given. So she strikes
with a hand strike for 1 agg.
